scientific_integrity.critical_computation: Finite full enumeration over all 1440 graph automorphisms and all 900 two-cell boundaries, reproducible from embedded Python code.
scientific_integrity.proof_method: Exact cubical chain complex, two-sided rational boundary-rank bound, signed full-group Lefschetz character, exact symmetric-group inner products

scientific_limitations: Ordinary unordered configuration space of exactly two points on the named 30-vertex graph only.
Integral H2 is classified only as an abelian group, not as an integral automorphism lattice.
H1 over Q and the rational H2 character are determined, but integral H1 torsion and the cohomology ring are not.
Exhaustive finite certificates apply to this graph only, not to arbitrary graph families.
Equivalent unindexed calculations cannot be ruled out; publication priority and independent mathematical auditing remain outstanding.
title: Full 1440-element homology character of two unordered particles on the Tutte–Coxeter graph
